name: Adevos-X Tech Backend
description: API for Adevos-X Tech — auth, bot deployment, payments, AV Coins, admin control.

APP_BASE.description: Tells the monorepo buildpack to build only the backend/ folder

JWT_SECRET.description: Long random string used to sign login sessions

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth Client ID (optional at first)

APPLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Apple Sign-In Client ID (optional at first)

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key for OTP/notification emails

ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL.description: Where new feedback notifications are sent

KOYEB_API_KEY.description: Koyeb API key for bot deployment

RENDER_API_KEY.description: Render API key for bot deployment

PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY.description: Paystack secret key for card payments

ADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD.description: Change this immediately after first login
